name: Nestlé Prepared Foods - Mount Sterling KY

fieldNotes.truckGate: Definitive - a single guarded entry off Oak Grove Dr on the SE. The campus is fully ringed by chain-link perimeter fence (confirmed in Street View 2025-06).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Definitive - a blue-roofed guard booth sits on a raised median island in the entry road with traffic lanes on both sides and directional arrows painted on the pavement; a barrier-arm structure is visible. Clear in z20-z21 imagery and Street View 2025-06.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: From the guarded gate, trucks route along a long perimeter drive to the warehouse docks (N) and drop yard (W) - ample queue depth.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large drop yard on the W side of the warehouse holds ~30+ trailers in two rows; additional trailers backed at docks. dropArea 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on two distinct buildings/faces - the N warehouse face and the SE manufacturing-building face - shipping and receiving physically separated.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entry road with a median island and large open yards provide room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~45 estimated across the warehouse N face and the manufacturing-building docks; partly obscured - low-confidence count.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus with two large building clusters - a warehouse/DC building (N) and a manufacturing plant building (central/S) - plus an on-site wastewater facility.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail line runs anywhere near the industrial park; not rail-served.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Mount Sterling is a small Kentucky town; the plant sits in an edge-of-town industrial park surrounded by farmland - rural.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly visible; flagged uncertain.
